docs: How to Prepare My Rental Application

s0.title: Create a Solid Rental Application to Find Your Dream Home
s0.text: DossierFacile helps you create a high-quality digital rental application
s0.text2: that you share securely with landlords and agencies.

s1.h1: Stand Out with a Complete Application
s1.p1: We guide you step by step to gather the documents expected in your situation.
s1.p2: You share via secure links, which you can suspend at any time.
s1.p3-after: answers your questions. If in doubt, request a verification of your file by an agent after submitting it.

s2.title: Create Your Rental Application in Three Steps
s2.p1: DossierFacile asks for the necessary documents and only those.
s2.p2: As soon as all your documents are uploaded, your application is complete and your documents are watermarked to protect you. Our teams remain available if you have a doubt about a document.
s2.p3: You create one link per recipient, with an expiration date. You track views and cut off access whenever you decide.

s3.title: Protect Your Personal Information
s3.text1: With DossierFacile, no more scattered identification papers.
s3.text2: Your documents are watermarked to protect you against fraud.
s3.text3: You share a link, and that link stays under your control.
s3.link: Learn more about data security at DossierFacile

s4.t1: Karim's application stood out immediately: it was the only complete application received!
s4.t2: Simple, efficient, and practical: it saved me a lot of time in my apartment search.
s4.t3: I could never visit an apartment with my foreign application. With DossierFacile, I finally got more viewings!
